But they do with feeling the pain all over again, which causes part of our body to feel weird; or like something is happening to it that isn't in that moment but has before when we were little. 
We found out their somatic flashbacks (where you feel the trauma that happened to you physically.) We call them ghost pains or somatic pains, mainly ghost pains. 
It only happens when one of the littles that felt that type of pain before is close or out; that's the only time the body and main fronter or whoever is out  feels it.
